title: When Does Momentum Help in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards?
abstract: arXiv:2610.20413v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Momentum is a classical tool for accelerating convex optimization and a standard component of modern large language model training. Yet recent empirical work has questioned the usefulness of first-moment momentum in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). We study this question through a bandit formulation of RLVR with bias-corrected exponential moving average (EMA) momentum, where the EMA coefficient $\beta$ controls how quickly the weights on past gradients decay. When policy gradients are evaluated exactly, we prove that increasing $\beta$ within a range that prevents overshoot strictly accelerates optimization. When gradients are estimated from sampled responses, a positive expected gain can be obscured by sampling fluctuations. translated_title: 动量何时有助于可验证奖励强化学习？
translated_abstract: 动量是加速凸优化的经典工具，也是现代大语言模型训练的标准组成部分。然而，近期的实证工作对一阶动量在可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）中的有效性提出了质疑。我们通过带有偏差修正指数移动平均（EMA）动量的RLVR多臂老虎机形式化来研究这一问题，其中EMA系数 $\beta$ 控制过去梯度权重衰减的速度。当策略梯度被精确计算时，我们证明在防止过冲（overshoot）的范围内增大 $\beta$ 能严格加速优化。当梯度从采样响应中估计得到时，正的期望增益可能被采样波动所掩盖。我们证明，随着学习率 $\eta$ 减小，固定 $\beta$ 下的期望增益比这些波动消失得更快，而增大 $\beta$ 以使 $\eta/(1-\beta)$ 保持在……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过带偏差修正EMA动量的老虎机形式化分析RLVR，理论上证明精确梯度下增大动量系数β可严格加速优化，而采样估计梯度下需增大β以维持有效步长η/(1-β)来克服采样波动。
en_tdlr: Through a bandit formulation of RLVR with bias-corrected EMA momentum, this paper proves that increasing the momentum coefficient β strictly accelerates optimization with exact policy gradients, while with sampled gradients, increasing β to maintain the effective step size η/(1-β) is necessary to overcome sampling fluctuations.
